item.title: Version 4.7.3
item.description:
• "Answer in terminal" no longer leaves the next waiting card stuck
  • Approvals stay on for Claude Code installed with nvm, volta or bun
  • "Only when blocked" sound is remembered after a restart
  • Clicking an option after typing sends just that option
  • A signed-out Claude account clears its old usage numbers
  • Long questions keep their answers

item.title: Version 4.7.2
item.description:
• Answer Conductor's questions from the notch (and any app that brings its own question tool): tap an option and Claude gets your answer
  • Type your own answer: every question card has a "Something else…" field
  • Peek no longer gets cut off at the bottom of a card when it reaches down for you

item.title: Version 4.7.1
item.description:
• Fixes the anonymous counts never being sent (the analytics library only sends while an app is "active", which a menu bar app rarely is)
  • The pill stays visible over the full-screen app your agents run in

item.title: Version 4.7.0
item.description:
• Answer from the notch: approvals now come from Claude Code's and Codex's own permission hooks, so a card appears exactly when the agent would ask; questions and plans can be answered there too
  • See what you approve: the full command, file edits as a diff, and Always allow saves Claude's own suggested rule for this project
  • Updates itself from now on: new versions download quietly and wait for a restart
  • Finished cards show files edited and test results; jump to the exact tab and tmux pane
  • Usage that's out of date says so, and "usage is back" when a window resets
  • Quieter: only blockers over full-screen apps, sound for blockers only, optional hiding from screen sharing
  • Gemini CLI (beta), Conductor questions shown in the notch, and a health check in Settings
  • Peek has a new icon, tricks between tasks, and dozes when things go quiet
